t: What Habitat Restoration Database Is All About
title: What Habitat Restoration Database Is All About
description: Habitat restoration rebuilds ecosystems: planting natives, removing invasives, re-wetting wetlands. Success is measured against baselines — survival rates, species return, function restored — over decades, not seasons. The Kissimmee River (Florida) re-meandering restored 40 square miles of floodplain; China's Loess Plateau went from dust to green. Reference ecosystems set the target; monitoring proves the outcome. This database is the complete restoration method: full records with definitions, key facts, procedures, and runnable demo programs, organized on a teaching ladder from Foundations to Advanced.
